lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: The schedule is void. Not because I argued it — I did not argue anything. Because I read it, and it cites a subsection that was struck at committee in 2061 and never reinstated.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: Four years of drafting, and the useful skill turned out to be reading. Nobody reads them. That is the entire profession and the entire vulnerability, and I have just used it for something.

lines.speaker: fence_moro
lines.text: Eleven stalls. Take anything off mine you like and I'll be insulted if you pay for it.
